user.title: NESO Demand Flexibility Service
user.description: Enter a UK postcode to find your DFS zone. Leave it blank to use the Home Assistant location.

participant.title: Track a participant (optional)
participant.description: Pick a registered DFS participant bidding in zone Z{zone} to follow, or leave it as None. Confirmed results are reported separately from the historical accept rate, which only applies while an auction is unsettled. You can change this later.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach NESO or the postcode lookup service.
error.outside_gb: That location is not inside any DFS zone. The service covers Great Britain only.

abort.already_configured: This DFS zone is already configured.

init.description: Pick a registered DFS participant to track. Confirmed results are reported separately from the historical accept rate, which only applies while an auction is unsettled.
